extracted.name: Quick Noodle-Veggie Bowls
extracted.description: These simple vegan noodle and veggie bowls are super adaptable and easy to use any cooked, leftover pasta you like.
instruction_lines: Heat oil in a skillet over medium-high heat. Add mushrooms, snow peas, carrot, and green onions. Cook, stirring, until crisp-tender, about 4 minutes. Add garlic; cook 1 minute more.
Stir together soy sauce, sugar, and cayenne in a small bowl; pour into skillet. Add cooked spaghetti and toss to coat. Cook until heated through, about 1 minute. Sprinkle with toasted sesame seeds.
